Card Q&A.q: If I have a [Mimi Tachikawa] in play, can I use this card's effect to play a [Palmon] from my hand without paying its memory cost?

Effect: [Main] If you have [Mimi Tachikawa] in play, you may play a [Palmon] from your hand without paying its memory cost to return 1 of your [Mimi Tachikawa] cards to its owner's hand.
Security Effect: [Security] Add this card to your hand.
